response.text: This isn't SQLite, so I'll use information_schema.

arguments.sql: SELECT table_schema, table_name, column_name, data_type, ordinal_position FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') ORDER BY table_schema, table_name, ordinal_position;
SELECT table_schema, table_name, table_type FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') ORDER BY 1,2;
